<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<title>Results</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:light dark;--bg:#fff;--ink:#10131a;--ink2:#5a6372;--rule:#e5e8ec;--soft:#f6f7f9;--accent:#2545c8;--amber:#8f5508;--amberbg:#fdf3e1;--red:#c0392b;--green:#1b7f5a}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#0d0f13;--ink:#e8eaee;--ink2:#8a93a0;--rule:#23272e;--soft:#14171c;--accent:#6a8cff;--amber:#e8b03e;--amberbg:#2a2113;--red:#ff8478;--green:#4fd39a}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.55 ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
main{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 20px 56px}
h1{font-size:24px;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 6px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.lead{color:var(--ink2);margin:0 0 18px;max-width:64ch}
.banner{background:var(--amberbg);border-left:4px solid var(--amber);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin:0 0 22px;font-size:14px}
h2{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--ink2);font-weight:600}section{margin-bottom:30px}
a{color:var(--accent);text-underline-offset:2px}:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:3px}
.brief{background:var(--soft);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:14px;border-left:4px solid var(--accent)}.brief.critical{border-left-color:var(--red)}
.top{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px}.chip{font-size:12px;line-height:1;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink2)}.chip.type{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}.chip.att{border-color:var(--amber);color:var(--amber)}.chip.critical{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red)}
.brief h3{font-size:18px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 8px}
.k{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);margin:10px 0 2px;font-weight:600}.brief p{margin:0}.brief ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px}
.who{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:10px}.decide{margin-top:10px;font-weight:600}
.acts{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}.acts a{font-size:13px;padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none}
.quiet{background:var(--soft);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px}
ul.l{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}ul.l li{padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:14px}
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:10px}.tile{background:var(--soft);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 12px}.tile .kk{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2)}.tile .v{font-size:20px;font-weight:700}
.foot{color:var(--ink2);font-size:13px}.err{color:var(--red)}
@media (max-width:640px){main{padding:18px 14px 40px}h1{font-size:21px}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}
</style>

If no product analytics tool is connected, connect one under integrations.","considered":"No read has run yet.","items":[],"monitor":[],"recent":[],"tiles":[{"k":"Usage findings in the flow","src":"main"}],"foot":"Refreshed by the Product Analyst every Monday. Counters are live."}</script>
<script>(function(){
var D;function el(t,c,x){var e=document.createElement(t);if(c)e.className=c;if(x!=null)e.textContent=x;return e}
function link(t,u){var a=el('a',null,t);a.href=u;a.target='_blank';a.rel='noopener';return a}
function sec(r,t){var s=el('section');if(t)s.appendChild(el('h2',null,t));r.appendChild(s);return s}
function field(b,k,v){if(!v)return;b.appendChild(el('div','k',k));b.appendChild(el('p',null,v))}
function list(b,k,a,links){if(!a||!a.length)return;b.appendChild(el('div','k',k));var u=el('ul');a.forEach(function(x){var li=el('li');if(links&&x.u){li.appendChild(link(x.t,x.u))}else{li.textContent=typeof x==='string'?x:x.t}u.appendChild(li)});b.appendChild(u)}
function render(){var r=document.getElementById('root');r.textContent='';
 r.appendChild(el('h1',null,D.headline));r.appendChild(el('p','lead',D.lead));if(D.banner)r.appendChild(el('p','banner',D.banner));
 var s=sec(r,'Needs a person');
 if(!D.items.length){var q=el('div','quiet');q.appendChild(el('b',null,'Nothing needs a person this week. '));q.appendChild(document.createTextNode(D.considered||''));s.appendChild(q)}
 D.items.slice(0,3).forEach(function(i){var b=el('article','brief'+(i.attention==='Critical'?' critical':''));var t=el('div','top');t.appendChild(el('span','chip type',i.type));t.appendChild(el('span','chip att'+(i.attention==='Critical'?' critical':''),i.attention));(i.domains||[]).forEach(function(d){t.appendChild(el('span','chip',d))});b.appendChild(t);
  b.appendChild(el('h3',null,i.title));field(b,'What we found',i.found);field(b,'Why it matters',i.why);list(b,'Evidence',i.evidence,true);field(b,'Our interpretation',i.interpretation);list(b,'What we do not know',i.unknown,false);field(b,'Recommended next step',i.next);
  if(i.reviewers)b.appendChild(el('div','who','Review: '+i.reviewers));if(i.decision)b.appendChild(el('div','decide',i.decision));
  if(i.actions&&i.actions.length){var a=el('div','acts');i.actions.forEach(function(x){a.appendChild(link(x.t,x.u))});b.appendChild(a)}
  s.appendChild(b)});
 if(D.monitor&&D.monitor.length){var m=sec(r,'Monitoring, not actionable yet');var u=el('ul','l');D.monitor.slice(0,5).forEach(function(x){var li=el('li');li.appendChild(x.u?link(x.t,x.u):document.createTextNode(x.t));u.appendChild(li)});m.appendChild(u)}
 if(D.recent&&D.recent.length){var c=sec(r,'Recently learned');var u2=el('ul','l');D.recent.slice(0,3).forEach(function(x){var li=el('li');li.appendChild(x.u?link(x.t,x.u):document.createTextNode(x.t));u2.appendChild(li)});c.appendChild(u2)}
 if(D.tiles&&D.tiles.length){var o=sec(r,'Output, not the goal');var g=el('div','tiles');D.tiles.forEach(function(t){var d=el('div','tile');d.appendChild(el('div','kk',t.k));var v=el('div','v','...');d.appendChild(v);g.appendChild(d);
  maskin.query(t.src).then(function(q){var n=q.total.count;if(t.group){var f=q.groups.filter(function(x){return x.key===t.group})[0];n=f?f.count:0}v.textContent=String(n)}).catch(function(e){v.textContent='Could not load';v.className='v err';v.title=e&&e.message?e.message:''})});o.appendChild(g)}
 r.appendChild(el('p','foot',D.foot||''))}
try{D=JSON.parse(document.getElementById('results-data').textContent);render()}catch(e){var r=document.getElementById('root');r.textContent='The page could not load. Try again.';r.className='err'}
})();</script></body></html>
